correctness.rationale: The full-vertex reduced Świątkowski complex computes the unordered graph-configuration homology. The included reconstruction gives chain dimensions 1771, 6468, 7644, and 2912, verifies that the boundary squares to zero, and gives exact finite-field boundary ranks 1770, 4689, 2911 over the field with two elements and 1770, 4690, 2911 over the field with three elements. A primitive 881-term integer degree-three cycle is checked exactly; the modular rank lower bound and this integral kernel vector force the integral top kernel to have rank one and to be generated by the primitive cycle.
